title: Size of the strict w-local construction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\kappa$ an infinite cardinal with $|A|\leq\kappa$. Let $C_A$ be the algebra defined by the strict w-local construction [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover], namely $W=A^w$, $E=W^{\mathrm e}$, and $C_A=E_{[V(IE)]}$ where $I$ is the radical ideal defining the closed points of $\operatorname{Spec}W$. Then $|C_A|\leq\kappa$.

source.place: Tag 0976, remark-size-w; Tag 097S, remark-size-T; Tag 0984, remark-size-w-contractible, the estimates for the first three stages only; Tag 097X, lemma-get-w-local-algebraic-residue-field-extensions, first paragraph of proof specifying these stages

proof.text: Work first in the universe of A with μ = max(|A|, aleph₀). The lemma [lem-weil-pbc-principal-w-localization-size] gives |W| = |A^w| ≤ μ.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-contraction-size] to W, obtaining |E| = |Wᵉ| ≤ μ. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-principal-w-localization-size] again, now to E, to obtain |E^w| ≤ μ.

Set T = V(IE), a closed set by PrimeSpectrum.isClosed_zeroLocus. The lemma [lem-weil-pbc-retained-localization-size] gives |E_[T]| ≤ |E^w|. By [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover] its carrier is C_A, so |C_A| ≤ μ. Finally lift this inequality to the common universe of A and κ. The hypotheses |A| ≤ κ and aleph₀ ≤ κ bound lift μ by lift κ, proving the exact universe-polymorphic statement.
